'''Reefa Been''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the male [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] known as [[Rep/Legends|Rep]] [[Been]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with locating Reefa Been in the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] countryside, and escorting her back to Rep Been in the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Reefa Been was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Reefa Been spawned under the generic "mission_plainsfolk" template, resulting in her consistently appearing as a Human female. Given Reefa Been's inclusion in Rep Been's [[W:c:swg:Quest|questline]], it is unclear if she was originally intended to be a Gungan relative of his. However, as Rep Been's quest dialogue was bugged, no mention was made of Reefa's physical characteristics. Therefore, this article assumes that the Human female depiction of Reefa is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, and that the surname of "Been" is merely coincidental. The questline that involved Reefa was removed from the game sometime after launch<ref name="AED" />
